notes: All seeds converged to near-random accuracy (10% baseline for 10 classes). val_loss ~2.30-2.37 = ln(10) = random. Root cause: per-timestep PC inference (T_pc=10 gradient steps modifying r_l at each t) conflicts with BPTT through W_rec. Inference steps create non-differentiable intermediate representations that corrupt the BPTT gradient signal. This is a meta-gradient interference problem: PC inference and BPTT compete for the same weights.
